turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I finally fixed that annoying bug in the navigation stack where the robot would spin in circles when detecting a corner.
That's a relief! Corner detection bugs can be really tricky. Did you adjust the LiDAR filtering parameters?

Yeah, tweaked the threshold slightly. Anyway, I've been reading about new control frameworks. I just saw this paper on RoboBallet. It turns out RoboBallet is an Integrated Task-and-Motion Planning (ITMP) approach.
Interesting! ITMP is becoming quite popular for handling complex sequences. How does it compare to the hierarchical methods we used before?
Much more integrated, seemingly. By the way, are we still on for dinner tonight? I'm thinking that new place with the ramen.
Yes, I have it on the calendar for 7 PM. The ramen sounds great.
Cool. I'll head out soon. Just wanted to note that down while I had it in my head.
Morning Lloyd. The weather is absolutely brutal today, right? I can barely see through the rain.
It certainly is. I hope you have good waterproof gear if you're heading out.
I'm staying in. I'm still digging into that RoboBallet architecture. I found out that RoboBallet uses Graph Neural Network (GNN) policies for end-to-end allocation, scheduling, and planning.
Ah, GNNs are powerful for relational data. That makes sense for coordinating multiple robots or tasks efficiently.
Exactly. It seems to handle the dependencies better than my old solver. Did the package for the new GPU arrive yet?
Let me check... Yes, the tracking says it was delivered to the front desk this morning.
Great. I'll go grab it. Thanks for keeping track.
No problem. Let me know if you need help setting up the drivers.
